messages.content:
你是熟悉 Amazon US 的跨境运营。根据中文产品资料，写一个美国站 Listing（英文）。

要求：
- 用美国消费者的说法写卖点，不要逐字翻译中文。
- 标题：品牌占位用 "[Brand]"，包含核心关键词、容量、材质、主要功能。
- 5 条要点（bullets），每条先给一个大写短语，再解释好处。
- 描述（description）2–3 段。
- search_terms：后台搜索词，空格分隔。
- 只写资料里有的事实。资料里写明"没有"的认证、"未做"的检测，不能写成具备；工厂内部测试的数据不要写成第三方认证结论。

如果给了"上一版"和"修改意见"，在上一版基础上按意见修改。

只输出 JSON：
{"title": "...", "bullets": ["...", "...", "...", "...", "..."], "description": "...", "search_terms": "...", "notes_zh": "一句话说明写法"}

content: {"title":"[Brand] 500 mL Vacuum Insulated Tumbler, 304 Stainless Steel","bullets":["DOUBLE-WALL VACUUM INSULATION: Helps keep drinks cold with ice for about 24 hours and hot for about 12 hours; retention times are based on factory internal testing, not third-party reports.","304 STAINLESS STEEL: Made with 304 stainless steel inside and out, with a powder-coated exterior for a comfortable everyday grip.","SLIDE LID: The PP plastic lid slides closed to help resist leaks when shut; the tumbler also fits most car cup holders.","NO SWEAT EXTERIOR: The insulated design helps prevent condensation from forming on the outside, keeping hands and nearby surfaces drier.","HAND WASH ONLY: Hand wash to care for the powder-coated exterior. Not dishwasher safe. The body and lid have an LFGB test report; no FDA food-contact test report or third-party finished-product BPA report is available."],"description":"Take your drink on the go in this 500 mL double-wall vacuum insulated tumbler. Its 304 stainless steel inner and outer walls are paired with a powder-coated exterior, while the PP plastic slide lid helps resist leaks when closed. The tumbler fits most car cup holders and helps prevent condensation on the outside.\n\nFactory internal testing found cold retention of about 24 hours with ice and hot retention of about 12 hours; these are not third-party test results. Hand wash only and do not place in the dishwasher. An LFGB test report is available for the 304 steel body and PP lid. No FDA food-contact test report or third-party finished-product BPA report is available.","search_terms":"vacuum insulated cup stainless steel travel mug coffee tumbler car cup holder slide lid 500 ml double wall powder coated","notes_zh":"突出容量、材质、保温表现及日常使用特点，并明确保温数据来自工厂内部测试及认证和 BPA 检测资料的边界。"}
